## Overview
### Introduction to Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct
The Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct model, provided by Alibaba Cloud, is a budget-friendly, open-source language model released on 2024-11-12. This model boasts an impressive architecture, with a context window of 131,072 tokens and a maximum output of 8,192 tokens. Its knowledge cutoff is 2024-09, ensuring it has a robust understanding of technical concepts up to that point. The Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct model is particularly strong in coding-related tasks, thanks to its capabilities in text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and system prompts.

### Technical Strengths and Use Cases
The Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct model excels in coding tasks, including code completion, debugging, code review, and technical documentation. It also performs well in simple agent-related tasks. With a high score of 92.7 on the HumanEval benchmark and 93.0 on the GSM8K benchmark, this model demonstrates its proficiency in coding challenges. Additionally, its MMLU score of 81.0 and LMSYS Arena ELO score of 1248 showcase its overall language understanding and competitive performance. However, it is not suited for tasks involving vision, general chat, research tasks, or audio. Developers can leverage this model for a wide range of coding applications, taking advantage of its budget-friendly pricing: $0.07 per 1M input tokens and $0.21 per 1M output tokens.

#### 1. **Code Completion**
Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct can be used to complete partially written code, reducing development time and increasing productivity. For example, when using OpenRouter, you can integrate Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct to suggest the next line of code:
```python

# Initialize Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct model
model = openrouter.Qwen25Coder32BInstruct()

# Partially written code
code = "def greet(name: str) -> None:\n    print(f\"Hello, {"

# Get code completion suggestions
suggestions = model.complete_code(code)

# Print suggestions
for suggestion in suggestions:
    print(suggestion)
```
